title: Sourdough Banana Bread

ingredients: 1 cup (200g) dark brown sugar (or light brown or white)
1/2 cup (125g) unfed sourdough starter or active starter
Optional: 1/2 cup chopped walnuts or pecans
directions: Preheat oven to 350°F (176°C) and lightly grease a 9x5-inch loaf pan.
Whisk together flour, baking powder, baking soda, and salt in a bowl and set aside. In a separate bowl, mash the bananas with a fork until smooth and set aside.

In a third bowl, melt the butter in the microwave. To the melted butter add the brown sugar, eggs, sourdough starter discard, vanilla extract, sour cream, and mashed bananas. Stir with a spatula until smooth.
Add the wet and dry ingredients together and stir until just combined. Do not over-mix. If adding walnuts, gently fold in with a spatula.
Pour the batter into the loaf pan and bake for 50–60 minutes or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean.
Cool in the loaf pan for 15 minutes. Gently run a knife along the inside of the pan to help release the loaf. Carefully transfer to a wire rack and cool before slicing.

notes: Store at room temperature for up to 3 days, wrapped in plastic or in a container with a lid. Freeze for up to 3 months tightly wrapped in foil and plastic.
